evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; growth-stage pressure and atmosphere cannot be fully verified.
Exhaust oxygen was 6.5 ppm at the start of growth.
Exhaust oxygen has risen progressively to 25.7 ppm; this is concerning but does not identify a specific fault.
Temperature is 749.9 °C against 750 °C setpoint, argon is 100.7 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not establish correct tube atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: Required tube-pressure measurement, an acceptable growth-stage oxygen range and verification of the rising oxygen signal are needed to assess atmosphere compliance; sample characterization is not yet available.
